title: Better than expected
text: Better than expected. I bought this chair because I hated to use the handle on the side of my old recliner. Also you could see the metal under neat the chair. I had to hand push it down or up for the back of the chair. This recliner cost less than my previous chair, which I hated and after 3 years donated to a charity. It came to my home within 3 days, UPS brought inside the room and even helped me unpack it, there was nothing to assemble. It is so wonderful made with memory foam, not bulky and huge, the electric motor works beautiful. It makes in to a bed, it goes down so far, you can do any position and height. You can see no metal when your feet are up. Material is high quality, easy to clean. Now my husband took this chair, he loves laying in it and make a nap. I have to get me another one, because he used to sit on our sofa. Everyone who visits sets in the chair to try it. I tell them where I bought it. None of us every seen such a quality chair for the money. The stores also want 75 delivery fee. I looked at all the chairs on Amazon and I would recommend this one to anyone, but if a person id very huge, you have to buy a different size. My husband and I are average 5'7 and 5'9  my husband weights 170.00 and my neighbor 250 and he fitted in the chair. Also the chair looks 10 times more beautiful than the picture.

product_metadata.title: Flash Furniture Contemporary Top Hat Chocolate Microfiber Power Recliner with Push Button
description: This power recliner will keep you in comfort with its plush upholstery. The recliner features a push button recline that allows you to easily situate yourself in multiple positions. Reclining furniture offers the best in relaxation for you to kick up your feet to watch TV, work on a laptop, or to just hang out with family and friends. Recliners provide good neck and lumbar support, making them the most popular seating choice for everyday use. If you're on the market for a powered recliner, this comfortably designed recliner will deliver.
